The '''Cloak''' was a group of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] present in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Cloak pilots flew [[Z-95-AF4 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95-AF4 Headhunters]], [[BTL-S3 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-S3 Y-wing starfighters]],<ref name="SWG:RtMF" /> [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]], [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptors]] and [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighters]].<ref name="SWG:CtCO">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=space|Capture the Cloak Officer|Corellian system}}</ref>

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Cloak appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RtMF" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Cloak was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:RtMF" />
